lines: Ayame had now come out to face me.
Her weapon was already taken and she had her hands up behind her head.
On top of that, Yukikaze was behind, guns thrusting into her.
I can shoot you at any time.
That said, she looked as if she wanted to shoot right then and there.
Due to Ayame threatening to snipe me, plus the fact Asagi-sensei had requested Sago's assassination, it seemed Yukikaze couldn't keep her cool.
I nodded and turned toward her.
Oh, your face is back to normal. Have you awakened to a healing-type Ninja Art or something?
Ayame said as she looked at my face which should've been battered and bruised but was now perfectly fine.
I'd already ordered her to make the bodyguards retreat to the casino.
Well, even a useless Diot like me has some room for improvement, you know?
It seems so. Being captured by you is my greatest shame as a sniper.
This is important so I wanted to get the answer straight from your lips.
I asked her the same question that I had posed earlier.
Did you kill Sago Bungo at Headmistress Asagi's request?
Yes, it was by her orders that I sniped him.
Yukikaze's hands holding her guns twitched.
I gestured for her to calm down and...
Huh!? Y-You're relieved!? What do you mean, Fuma!?
You mean you're relieved that Asagi-sensei requested Sago's assassination from this woman!?
No, Yukikaze. Ayame-san said she'd "sniped" him.
No, it's not. Isn't that right, Kurenai?
Although she didn't give off any signs of her presence, I knew it was her.
Kurenai emerged from the darkness where she was hiding.
She fixed her gaze on me with her striking blue eyes, inherited from her Vampire ancestry.
The invading soldiers were now at the Mizuki Estate, Yukikaze's castle.
Not only infantry units but as many as six powered exoskeletons were also deployed.
Put the Raidens in the vanguard.
That troublesome "Lightning Taimanin" should be away right now thanks to the Cabinet's plot.
『The one that can smash through even this kind of armor?』
『Who knows? But if she isn't here, there's nothing to worry about, right?』
Just make sure you don't take on that "Immortal Taimanin" who guards the castle.
They don't seem to have any effective means to damage a Raiden's armor, but our attacks won't work on them either.
Kurenai and I hadn't seen each other for a long while, but she appeared strangely restless.
If memory served, she'd always been dignified and worn an air of unattainability.
But perhaps she was somewhat bewildered that her trusted retainer Ayame had been so easily captured by me.
You didn't hear from Igawa Asagi?
Nothing. That's why I'm asking you, Kurenai.
Sorry. I'm in no position to answer that.
Kurenai lowered her gaze to avoid my eyes.
I have no idea what's what. Just explain it to me already!
To calm Yukikaze down, or rather in an attempt to elicit an answer from Kurenai,
I began to talk about Sago's assassination, my personal investigation of it, and the speculations I'd made based on the result.
Our mission was to escort Sago to the government.
And we were supposed to hand him over to the Cabinet.
However, it was only to be expected that once they got their hands on Sago, they would turn him into a guinea pig to study the UFS's cyborg technology.
That's why Headmistress Asagi had decided to stage his assassination.
It was to pull the wool over the eyes of the UFS and the Cabinet, who were both after Sago.
And one of the actresses whom Headmistress Asagi had chosen for the stage was Shinganji Kurenai.
If it's to save someone who's also from the Fuma Clan, there's no way you could've just rejected the request, could you?
Kurenai didn't answer, so I continued.
I told them that Mine from the Cabinet had contacted me.
And that she implied right in front of my face that Shinganji Kurenai and Headmistress Asagi conspired to assassinate Sago.
But when I heard her say you were involved in that assassination, Kurenai... I realized her story didn't add up.
As I said, there's no way you could've killed Sago. That would run against your principles.
The only possibility was that Mine was trying to lead me into something. So, I pretended to be duped to find out what it was.
Yukikaze had been quietly listening to me for a while, but she jumped with a start as I suddenly addressed her.
Mine knows about us so well, it's almost frightening.
Without even bringing up your name, she tried to lead me to assign you to this mission.
I noticed it, but I decided to go along with her anyway.
So that's why you brought only me...
Yukikaze seemed convinced for a moment but then suddenly seemed to realize something.
Ahh! So all that stuff about bringing only the best you knew was a lie!!
I didn't lie. I decided to bring you because I was sure I could outsmart Mine with you.
Mrrrgh. I feel like you're just trying to placate me but... Well, whatever. And then?
Apparently satisfied with my words for now, Yukikaze urged me to carry on.
So I thought, "What would Mine gain by having you accompany me on this mission? What's her goal?"
Not just Yukikaze, but both Kurenai and Ayame were waiting for my next words.
The answer is simple. It's Clear.
It was only natural for Yukikaze to react to the sudden mention of Clear's name, but Kurenai also seemed to know about her.
The mastermind behind Clear's previous attempt to assassinate Headmistress Asagiーit was probably Mine and the Cabinet.
It's possible that Clear still has the evidence somewhere in her body.
That's why Mine and the Cabinet want to recover Clear by any means necessary.
Wait! You figured out that much and you still separated me from Clear!?
I didn't necessarily separate you from her.
But that's what actually happened! I'm the one taking care of Clear now!!
It's alright. I have my most trusted forces at the castle. I was worried if it was just the old man there after all.
『Heh-heh! Come out, you dusty old ninja!』
The vanguard of six powered exoskeletons began their advance.
However, a shadow stood in their way.
Oni horns were visible between her big ribbons and pigtails.
And around her body were billowing clouds of icy mist.
Standing there was the hybrid Taimanin who held control over both Ninja Art and Iceー
Whoooaaa! S-Some bad guys really came, huh!?
Fuma-chan trusted Heberybody to protect this place. You guys are ready for this, right?
You villains!! We won't let you even set one foot in here!!
